title: English Conversation 33:  Slow Elevator
content: 1. What's wrong with...?: a question used to ask about the problem with something A) What's wrong with it? B) I don't know. A) What's wrong with the dog? B) It ate some cookies, so it is sick now. 2. to not be working: to be broken or not functioning properly - The TV is not working. - It is so hot in here. I want to turn on the fan, but it is not working. I need to fix it. 3. to be patient: to wait calmly - She is not patient. - Just be patient. It will come soon.
